## Sustainability news

### On a mission to a world without waste

We aim to collect back packaging for recycling equivalent to what we put out in the market by 2030.

[Learn more][23]
[Waves lapping the sand on a beach]

### Promoting Sustainable Agriculture

Our efforts are focussed on improving the overall fruit availability, increasing farming efficiency
as well as building food processing capacity in the country, thereby helping farmers increase their
income.

[Learn more][24]
[Oranges hanging in an orange grove]

## Presenting the “Super 30” glorious years of Limca® Book of Records!

This year’s Limca Book of Records is a combined edition of two challenging years and celebrates
stellar victories and accomplishments in human endeavor, education, adventure, business, cinema, the
natural world, literature, and the arts.

[ Learn more][25]
[Limca Book of records certificate]

## The 5 Essential Electrolytes

**Sodium**, **potassium** and **chloride** aid in fluid balance, which is important for maintaining
hydration inside and outside of cells. **Calcium** and **magnesium** are electrolytes found in
smaller concentrations in fluids inside and outside of cells and in sweat as compared to sodium and
chloride. As electrolytes, they are involved in cellular function.

## The 5 Essential Electrolytes

**Sodium**, **potassium** and **chloride** aid in fluid balance, which is important for maintaining
hydration inside and outside of cells. **Calcium** and **magnesium** are electrolytes found in
smaller concentrations in fluids inside and outside of cells and in sweat as compared to sodium and
chloride. As electrolytes, they are involved in cellular function.

POWERADE knows it takes more than skill to dominate the pitch — it takes endurance, focus, and the

minutes prior to working out can improve your body's physiological response to moderate exercise.

### [TNA Wrestling Brings A-GAME To All Future Live Events, Kicking Off Partnership at Slammiversary
### on July 20 at UBS Arena in New York][37]

July 18, 2025
ORLANDO, Fla., July 17, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TNA Wrestling today announced a partnership with
A-GAME Beverages, Inc., the ultimate hydration drink, to become the Official Hydration Partner of
TNA Wrestling following an agreement signed on July 17, 2025. Developed to provide essential
hydration for athletes and the general populace, A-GAME was founded by Johnny Damon, a two-time
all-star and two-time World Series champion. During his Major League Baseball career, he spent time
on seven teams from 1995-2012, including the Kansas City Royals (1995–2000), Boston Red Sox
(2002–2005) and New York Yankees (2006–2009). Damon is the Chairman of A-GAME, a hydration drink to
support active lifestyles at every level. The A-GAME partnership kicks off around TNA Wrestling’s
Slammiversary, the company’s showcase event of the year, held Sunday, July 20, at UBS Arena in New
York, the hockey home of the NHL’s New York Islanders. A-GAME will furnish bottles of its hydration
drink for all the TNA stars at Slammiversary and at all future live events. Damon is confirmed to
appear at Slammiversary. TNA executives are finalizing Damon’s additional involvement at
Slammiversary as he is a longtime pro wrestling fan who has appeared at and participated in past pro
wrestling shows. A-GAME delivers clean, functional hydration with natural sea salt for electrolytes,
eight essential vitamins, no artificial dyes or artificial sweeteners, and is sweetened with natural
ingredients and honey. “A-GAME isn’t just about performance — it’s also about great taste,” Damon
said. “Each flavor is crafted to be refreshing, smooth and enjoyable, whether you’re on the field,
in the gym, or in the wrestling ring.” Damon also will appear at the TNA SLAMMing Softball Classic
on Saturday, July 19, a charity softball game pitting the stars of TNA Wrestling against the
Coaching Staff of the Merrick Bellmore Little League Association in New York. The 7-inning game to
benefit the Merrick Bellmore Little League starts at 5 p.m. Bottles of A-GAME also will be on the
bench for the TNA softball stars. “We’re thrilled to welcome A-GAME as the Official Hydration
Partner of TNA Wrestling,” said TNA Wrestling President Carlos Silva. “It’s great to partner with a
two-time World Series champion, Johnny Damon, one of the most popular players to ever wear a Major
League uniform. “We know A-GAME will elevate our wrestler’s in-ring performance and post-match
recovery.” A-GAME also will have a presence at all future Invicta FC shows, providing the best
hydration drink to the women’s MMA promotion founded in 2012 by Janet Martin and Shannon Knapp.
Invicta FC and TNA Wrestling are both owned by the Canada-based Anthem Sports & Entertainment. About
TNA Wrestling: A subsidiary of Anthem Sports & Entertainment Inc. and a division of Anthem Sports
Group, Total Nonstop Action (TNA) Wrestling® is one of the world's top wrestling brands, producing
over 200 hours of original content annually and televised in 200 countries including AXS TV in the
United States. Founded in 2002, TNA Wrestling’s deep library of premium content is streamed across
the world on key OTT platforms including Pluto TV, Roku SamsungTV Plus and its own on-demand
subscription service TNA+©. TNA Wrestling has a powerful social media presence with over 10 million
engaged followers across all major services. Ancillary businesses include live events, merchandise,
licensing, and sponsorship. Media Contact: Ross Forman Head of Media Relations TNA Wrestling (847)
542-9350 About A-GAME Beverages, Inc.: Backed by All-Star athletes and partners Johnny Damon, Major
League Baseball Champion, Chairman and Co-Founder of A-GAME Beverages, Inc.; Bo Jackson, Major
League Baseball All-Star and NFL All-Pro, A-GAME Board of Directors member and arguably one of the
greatest athletes of all time; Caleb Downs, College Football National Champion; American country
music singer, songwriter and record producer; Tracy Lawrence; and Tim Hardaway Sr., a former
American professional basketball player, among others. A-GAME is on a mission to equip athletes of
all levels with the highest quality hydration beverages so you can always #BringYourAGAME. To learn

## Health is a process.

LMNT Co-Founder Robb Wolf shares the health journey that sparked a Salty Rebellion.

### I needed more salt. period.

I'd been on a low-carb, whole food diet for years, but something was holding me back. While working
with my coaches, we unlocked a powerful insight: I needed more salt. Period.
[Robb Wolf Wrestling]

### Popular products didn't cut it.

They're too high in sugar and woefully lacking in actual electrolytes — so we were making our own at
home, but that was messy and time-consuming. When I dialed in the formulation I immediately felt my
fitness, sleep, and brain functioning on new levels.
[Current Market Products]

### So we created LMNT.

Turns out, I needed to pay as much attention to my electrolytes as I did my food. And I’m not alone
— we’ve seen this play out across thousands of health journeys. My coaches helped me with this
critical missing link — I hope LMNT can be as meaningful for you.

[ [モンスターエナジー マンゴーロコ]
モンスターエナジー マンゴーロコ][93]
遂に日本で発売されることとなったモンスターエナジー

モンスターエナジー パイプラインパンチ][94]

た。本家アメリカをはじめ、世界各国で発売されるほど人気が高い注目の一本です。

アワライズ][95]

[ [モンスターエナジー マンゴーロコ]
モンスターエナジー マンゴーロコ][93]
遂に日本で発売されることとなったモンスターエナジー
マンゴーロコ。アメリカ版との比較レビューもしています。本家と日本版では濃さや果汁の密度が違い、好みが
わかれるかもしれませんが、ドリン君は日本版マンゴーロコのほうが飲み終えたあともまたもう一本飲みたくな
る美味しさに感動しました。

[ [モンスターエナジー パイプラインパンチ(日本)]
モンスターエナジー パイプラインパンチ][94]
モンスターエナジー史上最高クラスの美味しさを誇るパイプラインパンチが日本でも登場。果汁配合のトロピカ
ルフルーツフレーバーです。発売から1ヶ月で生産が追いつかなくなり、一時販売中止になるほど人気が出まし
た。本家アメリカをはじめ、世界各国で発売されるほど人気が高い注目の一本です。

[ [アワライズ]
アワライズ][95]
徳島県発、阿波おどり専用エナジードリンクとして発売され、現在は全国に少しずつ販路を拡大している柚子果
汁配合の絶品エナジードリンク。一度飲んだらリアルな柚子果実の美味さに誰もが驚く国産ブランド最高峰の味
。国産エナジードリンクで美味しさを追求した先駆けのような存在です。

[ [NOSエナジードリンクシリーズ]
NOSエナジードリンクシリーズ][96]

いています。NOSオリジナルはフルーティーな味わいで、2014年にエナジードリンクマニアでレビューをしたと
ころ話題になり、米軍基地開放イベントで即売り切れてしまうほど大旋風を巻き起こしました。

[ [ZONe エナジードリンク]

サーを活用した拡散やオンライン・オフラインともに多くのキャンペーンで認知度を上げています。

[ [マリオのエナジードリンク]

# UK's Leading FMCG Marketing Agency

## 
## Expert in Securing Distribution & Driving Demand for FMCG Brands

## 

## Finn Agency is a specialist FMCG marketing agency that helps food and beverage brands win in
## retail. From [FMCG branding][21] and [CPG marketing][22] to retail activation and demand
## generation, we build programmes that secure distribution and drive sell-through for the UK's most
## ambitious [consumer goods brands.][23]

## OUR FMCG BRANDS: JASON'S SOURDOUGH, GAROLLA, PROTEIN WORKS, ROWNTREE'S, Veetee & VERY LAZY.﻿

### SECURE DISTRIBUTION

We help FMCG brands get retail-ready, whether you're launching a new food and beverage product or
refreshing your presence in the trade. Our [FMCG marketing services][24] include B2B creative,
retailer sales strategy, and trade activation designed to win listings with the UK's top retailers.

[ FIND OUT MORE ][25]

### DRIVE DEMAND

We drive demand for consumer goods brands through creative campaigns that connect with your audience
and accelerate sell-through. Our FMCG advertising and [FMCG branding][26] programmes combine brand
strategy, consumer PR, and influencer marketing to build brands that win on the shelf.

[ FIND OUT MORE ][27]

## FMCG Brands We've Scaled

This is where the good stuff happens. We're all about turning ideas into reality here at Finn and
we're excited to show you what we've been up to.

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

Quality Ingredients

HYPNO Energy Drink gets its rich taste and colour from these quality ingredients

Water, Sugar or glucose / fructose syrup, Carbon dioxide, Acidity regulator; Citric acid and Sodium
citrate, Flavorings, Colourant; Caramel, Riboflavin, Sweeteners; Aspartame, Acesulfam K, Sodium

Hypno Energy Drink

HYPNO Energy Drink is produced by Baran Foods, Istanbul Turkey. Our group of companies has been
trading, import & exporting textiles for past twenty years. We started diversifying in manufacturing
of Apparels in 2004 and opened our food chain division in 2009. We further diversified in real
estate development in the year 2011.

 

Our Chairman of the group of companies is managing the group with his hard work and dynamic vision.
His mission is to prove best of the services and products to its clients with utmost satisfaction.
General Manager and Executive Director of the group is well equipped with the knowledge and
experience of International business. He has long diversified practical experience of three decades
in international business operators.

 

The group’s slogan , “Quality & Satisfaction” is being taught and practiced by every member of the
company. Group’s head office is located in the Kagithane municipality of Istanbul city, Turkey.

Distributor Enquiries

We welcome you to be part of HYPNO Energy Drink management and distribution partner in your country.

We offer one channel of distribution in any one country.

Retail partners set the prices of items on the Instacart marketplace. While many retailers offer

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# Nestlé Health Science empowers healthier lives through nutrition

As a global leader in the science of nutrition, we nourish those who need extra care, fill nutrition
gaps and provide innovative products for a healthier future, enabling customers and patients to live
their healthiest lives.

#### News

We’re a team of more than 12,000 people around the world dedicated to the science of nutrition. Find
out about our latest innovations, research, events and more.

[Search jobs ][173] #### Internships & programs On the way to your bachelor’s or MBA, work experience with PepsiCo is exciting and transformative. [Learn more ][174] #### Find pepsiCo Events near you Let’s meet up! In-person and virtual recruiting events happen around the world throughout the year. [Search events ][175] Our culture ### More than just a food and beverage company We dare to make the world smile and to put each other first. [Learn more][176] Innovation ### Work with some of the world’s most iconic brands PepsiCo’s range of thousands – yes, thousands! — of foods and beverages make consumers smile all around the globe. When you work at PepsiCo, you’re on a team daring to take these brands to the next level. [Learn more about our brands][177] ### PURPOSE-DRIVEN AGRICULTURE PepsiCo associates are helping shape what’s next in agriculture — working with farmers, strengthening supply chains, and advancing pep+. ## The home of driver and fleet risk management

**At TTC, we don’t think there are bad drivers. Just busy people who could benefit from insight into
their impact on road safety. And that’s definitely something we can change.**

If you employ a driver – even if it’s only one – you are responsible for making sure they’re as safe
as possible, entitled to drive and that their vehicle is taxed and roadworthy.

The benefits go beyond better safety and compliance. They’ll save you money, protect your reputation
and could help you win new business.

TTC motivates drivers to adopt safer practices with exceptional in-person, on-road and online
training, from Driver CPC workshops to bespoke courses.

Our world-first Continuum platform is all you need to bring risk, compliance and driver training
together, drive continuous improvement and evidence your duty of care.

Using data insight, automation and expert remediation, Continuum transforms your driver risk and
compliance and eradicates hours of unproductive admin time.

You can improve decision-making and assurance with intuitive management information too. Continuum’s
end-to-end performance reporting provides fully documented audit trails as well as supporting
evidence for contracts and tenders.

Flexibly build the service you need from a range of core and value-add products, some of them
pay-as-you-go, and scale them as you need. 750,000 drivers and over 4,000 clients can’t be wrong.

Welcome to the future of driver management.

## The home of driver and fleet risk management

**At TTC, we don’t think there are bad drivers. Just busy people who could benefit from insight into
their impact on road safety. And that’s definitely something we can change.**

If you employ a driver – even if it’s only one – you are responsible for making sure they’re as safe
as possible, entitled to drive and that their vehicle is taxed and roadworthy.

The benefits go beyond better safety and compliance. They’ll save you money, protect your reputation
and could help you win new business.

TTC motivates drivers to adopt safer practices with exceptional in-person, on-road and online
training, from Driver CPC workshops to bespoke courses.

Our world-first Continuum platform is all you need to bring risk, compliance and driver training
together, drive continuous improvement and evidence your duty of care.

Using data insight, automation and expert remediation, Continuum transforms your driver risk and
compliance and eradicates hours of unproductive admin time.

You can improve decision-making and assurance with intuitive management information too. Continuum’s
end-to-end performance reporting provides fully documented audit trails as well as supporting
evidence for contracts and tenders.

Flexibly build the service you need from a range of core and value-add products, some of them
pay-as-you-go, and scale them as you need. 750,000 drivers and over 4,000 clients can’t be wrong.

Welcome to the future of driver management.

[Explore Continuum][122]
[Horiba logo]

> “The Continuum system is a fantastic tool that makes monitoring the licence and vehicle compliance
> of our drivers very simple.”
> 
> Rich McNab, Health and Safety Manager, Horiba

### Peace of mind for customers and employees

[2 million hours of driver training]

## Explore our products

### Identifying Driver & Fleet Risk

Dynamically profile all your drivers, identify the riskiest and positively intervene with automated
tools, tasks and alerts informed by Continuum data.

[Driver risk][124]

### Manage compliance

Stay compliant with automated driver licence and grey fleet checks in Continuum and never get caught
out by driving bans, insurance expiry and missing documents again.

[Compliance][125]
[Driver training]

#### All the training you’ll ever need

Develop a road safety culture and aid staff retention with engaging driver education from UK experts
nationwide. CPC training, bespoke courses and more. We have got it all.

[Training][126]

## The benefits for your business

[TTC Icons 47 Increase Graph Chart (alt)]

**Boost safety and productivity.**
Find and positively influence your risky drivers and reduce accidents, off-road time and insurance
premiums.

[TTC Icons 58 Legal Police Legislation Conviction]

**Protect your reputation and avoid penalties.**
Make sure your drivers are legal and that their vehicles are insured, taxed and roadworthy at all
times.

[TTC Icons 61 Money Cost Saving Piggy (alt)]

**Improve efficiency, employee satisfaction and save money.**
Remove hours of manual admin and hassle by using streamlined automated processes and alerts.

[TTC Icons 41 Driver Assess Risk]

**Evidence your duty of care 24/7.**
Keep your finger on the pulse with centralised data and intuitive e2e reports to aid investigations,
audits and accreditation.

[TTC Icons 31 Driver Behaviour Attitude]

**Take the pain and aggravation from managing training.**
Manage driver CPC training and records in one place and get reminders so you never miss a deadline.

[TTC Icons 52 Shield Complaince Protect]

**Enjoy ultimate peace of mind.**
Use our consultancy services for advice. We provide fleet safety surveys, policy writing and
guidance with no ties.

[The Continuum Platform][127]

## With TTC you’re in safe hands

**TTC is the UK’s leader in driver safety. We deliver millions of hours of in-person, on-road and
online training, more than a million licence checks and help to reduce work related road risk for
hundreds of businesses every year.**

Our powerful Continuum platform is the industry’s only all-in-one tech-driven driver risk and
compliance tool, combining decades of TTC expertise with data and automation to improve performance
and reduce cost. 

Join the growing number of enlightened businesses choosing TTC for duty of care, peace of mind and
innovative and effective services assured to the highest international standards of quality and
information security.

## OEM Beverage Manufacturing Process — Concept to Export-Ready in 8–10 Weeks

Wana's structured 6-step process takes your project from initial concept to export-ready production
in 8–10 weeks. Every stage is managed in-house — from R&D sampling and packaging design to
production, QC inspection, and international shipment coordination.

04

Plan materials, run production and control batch consistency.

05

### QC Inspection

06

Coordinate loading, export documents and delivery schedule with the buyer.

Case Study

### EU Functional Beverage Brand

A European functional beverage brand approached Wana to develop a sparkling prebiotic soda and
collagen drink line for the German and Dutch retail market. Wana's R&D team completed initial
samples within 10 days, handled BRCGS-compatible documentation, and managed EU import compliance.
The brand launched 3 SKUs within 11 weeks of first contact, with a recurring quarterly order of 2
containers per SKU.

Case Study

### Retail Private Label Chain

A US retail chain needed a reliable private label beverage supplier for their in-house brand across
coconut water and aloe vera categories. After a trial order of 1×20ft container, they scaled to a
monthly supply agreement covering 8 SKUs across 3 categories. Wana managed full label design
adaptation, local regulatory documentation, and consistent batch color and taste across 12
consecutive shipments.

Case Study

### Middle East Distributor

A UAE-based food distributor required a HALAL-certified coconut water and juice portfolio for
distribution across Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Bahrain. Wana developed 5 formulas with Arabic-language
label support, obtained HALAL certification for each SKU, and coordinated Gulfood exhibition
sampling. The distributor signed a 12-month supply agreement covering 6 containers per month.

ABOUT
US

At XL Energy, we have been dedicated to delivering high-quality energy drinks since 1999.
Headquartered in Warsaw, with a state-of-the-art production facility in central Poland, we are proud
to control every step of our product creation process, from research and development to
manufacturing.

Our R&D department and lab enable us to take full responsibility for product quality, ensuring it
meets the highest standards, proven by internationally respected certifications.

With over 2 billion products sold worldwide, our energy drinks are available on 5 continents,
reflecting our global reach and commitment to innovation. We believe in building a sustainable,
transparent, and ethical business while prioritizing health and safety in everything we do. Our
brands are designed to meet the diverse needs of consumers around the world, offering a refreshing
energy boost for all lifestyles. We also collaborate closely with our distributors, sharing our
marketing expertise to drive success in every market.
